title: Syn-STARTS: Synthesized START Triage Scenario Generation Framework for Scalable LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical proficiency of LLMs in following the START clinical triage algorithm. While triage involves resource allocation decisions with inherent ethical weight, the evaluation is based on adherence to deterministic procedural rules rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or moral philosophy. Mentions of fairness and bias appear in the context of clinical sensitivity and future research directions.
